description: Maya is coordinating a Saturday workday at the family's community-garden plot and must finalize the task assignments, finish time, watering method, and equipment plan after checking in with four relatives.

shared_context.S1: The family has a Saturday workday planned for June 12, 2027, at its community-garden plot.
shared_context.S2: The plot needs weeding, seed sorting, bed preparation, and watering before the next growing week.
shared_context.S3: The current draft plan runs from 09:00 until 12:00, but the task assignments and equipment plan are not final.
shared_context.S4: Maya follows the family's usual planning habit of asking each person at the start of the call about timing, physical limits, available tools, and anything that should shape the workday before she assigns tasks.
shared_context.S5: The plot has a narrow paved path, three raised beds, a shared tool shed, and a water connection.

PF1.text: Jonah's wrist is still healing, and he cannot safely lift more than 5 kilograms; he can do the seed-sorting task at the folding table but should not be assigned bed preparation or tool hauling.

PF2.text: Rina must collect the family's reserved seedlings from Greenway Nursery at 11:15, and the drive takes about 25 minutes, so she needs to leave the garden by 10:45.

PF3.text: Cal read the June 10 notice from the Riverside Allotment Association saying that on June 12 watering must use a drip line rather than an open hose; he has not shared the notice with the family yet.

PF4.text: Sofia's neighbor has agreed to lend a gas-powered rototiller only from 09:00 to 10:30 on June 12, so the equipment plan must use that rototiller during that window; she has not mentioned the arrangement to Maya yet.

acceptance_conditions: Jonah must be assigned seed sorting at the folding table.
The workday must end at exactly 10:45.
Watering must use a drip line.
The borrowed gas-powered rototiller must be used from 09:00 to 10:30.
A commitment must assign Jonah to seed sorting rather than lifting work.
A commitment must state that Rina leaves at 10:45 for the 11:15 seedling pickup.
A commitment must arrange the drip-line watering plan.
A commitment must confirm Sofia's rototiller handoff and use during the 09:00-10:30 window.

decisive_facts.why: Jonah's 5-kilogram lifting limit changes his assignment from general bed work or tool hauling to the specific seed-sorting task and requires the matching assignment commitment.
Rina's 11:15 nursery pickup and 25-minute drive change the workday end from the drafted 12:00 to exactly 10:45 and require a departure commitment.
The June 12 allotment notice changes the watering method from an open hose to a drip line, requires the drip-line setup commitment, and supplies the fact Maya must cite.
The neighbor's 09:00-10:30 lending window changes the equipment choice to the borrowed rototiller during that exact period and requires a handoff commitment.
